answer: Each identity posts a $50 bond and carries a jade audit badge that only a passed check renews. Every epoch a lottery draws 1 in 20 badges, and the auditor traces the trellis of wallets funding each one. A failed audit fines $200, then doubles up the fine terrace: $400, $800, $1,600, $3,200. One honest agent pays $50 and nothing else. An attacker with 100 clones pays $5,000 in bonds plus $6,200 in fines after five audits, and ten caught clones cost $204,600 before the cluster is voided. Each new fault doubles the next fine, so clones strangle each other like weeds on one trellis.
